text.p: There is high momentum in shares in Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy with the next resistance level at 250.00 markka, said Petri Korpineva, managing director of technical analysts Delphi on Friday.
He saw support at 200.00 markka. At 1225/0925 GMT, Nokia traded up 5.30 markka at 218.10 after touching an intrasession year-high of 219.00.

Although he said Nokia's volatility made it a high-risk stock, he said the momentum in the share was very strong on the back of U.S. tech stock gains, and the moving averages used by Delphi had given a buy signal on August 11.
But overall, he was not enthusiastic about the stock's potential: "I think Nokia's upside potential is not so good. It's mainly boosted by techs in the U.S.," he said.
